answer: Score trust by effective resistance from the honest seeds, not raw edges. Treat the attestation graph as a circuit and measure each identity's resistance-distance to the seeds: honest members sit close via many short redundant paths in smooth velvet; a sybil cluster hides behind a thin wharf of links, so current barely flows and resistance stays high however dense its internal mutual vouches. One bottleneck caps the whole clique at once — no falcon-swift shortcut exists. High resistance flags a manufactured region; it feeds the hard non-kin quorum and bond gates, never a payout.
